name: Hitozuma Ryoujoku -...Watashi Mou Gaman Dekinai...-
original_name: 人妻陵辱　-…私もう我慢できない…-
source:
Beautiful bride Bianca's fate changes drastically by your decisions.
Pure love with the protagonist.
Assault with monsters.
Love and r*pe. Two paths to obscenity.
Which will you take her down?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ064749.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
美丽的新娘Bianca的命运会因你的选择而彻底改变。
与主角相恋，或遭怪物侵犯——纯爱与强暴，两条通往淫荡的路线。
你会将她引向哪一条？

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ064749.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
